'''Stimufrost''' was a type of [[Color/Legends|blue]]-colored substance that could be consumed by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the influential [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Thalassa Tarkin]] ordered stimufrost to be administered to all of the guests attending the [[Thirteenth Imperial Diplomatic Conclave]], a gathering of high-ranking dignitaries on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] leader who was posing as a servant girl, administered some stimufrost to the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] on full-strength, but she sprayed too much of the substance at him and almost froze his face.
